claim: A yeast cell can increase the flux through a central metabolic pathway by changing the location of an enzyme when it runs out of fuel.
source: When a yeast cell runs out of fuel, it can increase the flux through a central metabolic pathway by simply changing the location of an enzyme.
evidence: This is stated in the abstract as a main finding of the work, presented as an established fact.

claim: Enzyme relocalization is a mechanism for metabolic regulation in response to starvation in yeast.
source: When a yeast cell runs out of fuel, it can increase the flux through a central metabolic pathway by simply changing the location of an enzyme.
evidence: This is logically inferred from the statement that location change of an enzyme increases pathway flux in response to fuel depletion, implying a regulatory mechanism.
